t: What he said weeping in prostration during the eclipse
a: رَبِّ لَمْ تَعِدْنِي هَذَا وَأَنَا أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لَمْ تَعِدْنِي هَذَا وَأَنَا فِيهِمْ
p: Rabbi lam taʿidnī hādhā wa anā astaghfiruk, lam taʿidnī hādhā wa anā fīhim
m: My Lord, did You not promise me that You would not do this while I am asking Your forgiveness? Did You not promise me this while I am among them?
